headline: President Clinton's 1994 order dealt with a Trade and Environment Policy Advisory Committee, a group that advises on trade and environmental issues.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order concerns an advisory committee on how trade policy and environmental policy connect. Advisory committees like this usually give advice to federal officials and do not make binding rules. No summary was provided, so the exact details, such as who serves on the committee and what it was asked to do, are not known from this source.

who_it_affects.how: They would likely receive advice from the committee on trade and environmental matters.
